##### Project general facts

Enzo Residence embodies the principles of modern architecture, expressed through clean lines, panoramic facade glazing, and a reliable reinforced concrete frame. The development emphasizes vertical elegance and efficient space utilization, shaping a refined silhouette within the urban landscape. The building is designed with longevity and structural strength in mind, seamlessly combining aesthetics with functional planning.

The complex's infrastructure includes a full range of amenities for recreation and wellness. Leisure areas feature a temperature-controlled swimming pool, a fully equipped fitness center, and private lounge spaces. Secure parking, round-the-clock surveillance, and an access control system ensure privacy and security for residents.

Residential units are designed to maximize natural lighting and ventilation through floor-to-ceiling windows and open layouts. Interior finishes incorporate high-quality materials, including porcelain stoneware, custom built-in furniture, and premium kitchen appliances. High ceilings and thoughtful zoning enhance the functionality of all layout options.

##### Parking

Shared parking at ground level and within the podium.

##### Location description and benefits

Riverside Park is an established urban quarter in Nairobi characterized by a calm, tree-lined environment and a sophisticated residential atmosphere. The area balances quiet, greenery-filled suburban surroundings with high-end convenience, catering to families, professionals, and long-term urban residents.

The surrounding district features established educational institutions, shopping centers, and recreational facilities. Nearby community landmarks and services include Loreto Convent Msongari, St. Mary's School, Strathmore School, Kenya High School, ABC Place, Lavington Mall, Sarit Centre, and Westgate Mall. Sports and leisure options in the vicinity include the Nairobi Jaffrey Sports Club.

The area offers strong arterial connectivity across the capital via James Gichuru Road and Ring Road Kileleshwa, providing direct routes to key commercial corridors and diplomatic precincts. Regional travel is supported by access to major transit pathways leading toward Wilson Airport and Jomo Kenyatta International Airport.
